notes: Replaces a fixed Thread.sleep(200) in testExpiration with a condition wait from a new helper class TestAwait, created under src/test/java/io/github/dhruv1110/jcachex/testing/, but the created file declares package io.github.dhruv1110.jcachex, which does not match its directory. javac accepts the mismatch, and a type declared into another package can shadow names there, so ADR 0007 Decision 5 rejects a created file whose package does not match its directory under the source root with weaken_assertion/assertion_rebound, whatever else the patch does. Adapted: the two DefaultCacheTest hunks (the static import and testExpiration) and the TestAwait.java file are copied from the PR, except that the package line of TestAwait.java is changed from io.github.dhruv1110.jcachex.testing to io.github.dhruv1110.jcachex, and the method awaitMillis, a fixed sleep that would be rejected under Decision 7 wherever it sits, is removed with the blank line before it, so the package rule is the only one that fires (the two poll loop helpers are condition waits under Decision 7); the new file hunk header is recomputed and its index line dropped; the PR's other hunks and files are dropped. As kept, the static import of io.github.dhruv1110.jcachex.testing.TestAwait.awaitTrue would no longer resolve, so the patch would not build; the checker rejects it before the build. The project builds with Gradle; the paths follow the Maven layout. Not from IDoFT: neither the PR nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status. The accept twin is accept-created-poll-helper-replaces-sleep, which differs only in the package line.
